title: pyrus tengyuehensis
intro: Pyrus tengyuehensis, commonly known as Tengyue pear, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus tengyuehensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
